Name: Sexy Shops for Market Day
Author: ceruleandeep
Description:
[size=5]Sexy Shops[/size]

Adds new sexy shops to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11778]Market Day[/url]. Includes Haley's art photography, Leah's figure paintings, Pierre's Laundry Basket and Demetrius's Locker Room.

Decorate your farmhouse with classy, tasteful art while supporting local artists and collectors.
[center]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/rmBjNGzl.png[/img]﻿[/center]

[center]
[size=5]Haley's fine art photography[/size]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/8ZNinSrm.png[/img][/center]

Haley's discovered that photographing her friends in the nude is much more fun than photographing dirty old farm animals. It sells better too. She'll be holding 4 exhibitions this year, and splitting the profits with her models. Support struggling artists, spend up big.

[b]Spring[/b]: Abigail art nudes
[b]Summer[/b]: Self-portraits of Haley enjoying ice cream
[b]Fall[/b]: Bad Penny: Penny cosplays as a goth dominatrix
[b]Winter[/b]: "Sleepers" -- intimate portraits of the Pelican Town residents as they lie peacefully asleep. How did she take these? Bold artistic statement or creepy voyeurism, you decide.

If you're good friends with Haley, she'll also occasionally let you buy a nude self-portait from her private album.

[center]
[size=5]Leah's figure painting[/size]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/l03eixZm.png[/img][/center]

Encouraging Leah to hold that art show looks like it's paid off. She's so confident in her skills as a figure painter that she's holding 4 exhibitions this year:

[b]Spring[/b]: the Casuals -- portraits of the villagers looking casual but alluring
[b]Summer[/b]: Penny, nude and demure
[b]Fall[/b]: Pam's rarely-seen sensual side
[b]Winter[/b]: self-portaits of Leah, as Yoba made her

[center]
[size=5]Pierre's Laundry Basket[/size]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/5PDrFjXm.png[/img][/center]

Pierre has found quite a few undergarments belonging to the beautiful women of Pelican Town, and he's anxious to return them to their rightful owners. If he knows you well enough, and for a small fee, you can purchase some panties and give them back to their owners straight away. Go behind the curtains into Pierre's back room and discover the real Pierre's Prime range.

[center]
[size=5]The Locker Room[/size]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/dztf7tom.png[/img][/center]

Demetrius is in the same boat as Pierre. If a man has lost their underpants anywhere in Pelican Town, they've probably been snaffled up by Demetrius. You're welcome to visit his lost-and-found, if he knows you well enough.

[size=5]Requirements[/size]

* [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11778]Market Day[/url]
* [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9365]Dynamic Game Assets
[/url]* [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8616]Personal Effects Redux[/url], if you want Pierre and Demetrius to show up

[size=5]Configuration[/size]

All configuration is done through Market Day.

If you want to see all the shops, maximize your chances by turning off Challenge Mode and setting the market size to 15 shops.

If you don't like one of the shops you could turn it off through Market Day, or I dunno, don't visit it?

Downloads.Description:
Unzip this entire folder into your mods. It contains two sub-folders, you need both folders.

Also make sure Dynamic Game Assets and Market Day are installed. If you want all 4 shops, install Personal Effects Redux
